jobs.title: Senior Scientist (In vitro / Cellular Pharmacology), Cambridge, MA
jobs.content: <p>Design biological screening cascades for peptide drug design programmes: biophysical, biochemical and cell-based functional assays; quantitative in vitro pharmacology.</p>

jobs.title: Senior Scientist / Research Scientist (Biologics), London
jobs.content: <p>Lead the hands-on design, optimisation and experimental validation of novel large-molecule therapeutics (antibodies, protein binders) with our generative AI design engine.</p>

jobs.title: Research Intern, Experimental Biology (Summer 2027)
jobs.content: <p>A 12-week internship in our London wet lab: mammalian cell culture, cell-based assays and imaging to test AI-designed molecules. Open to students currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD programme in cell biology, biochemistry or a related field.</p>
